subject.title: fix(ios): stabilize chat streaming layout and session flow

question: Should maintainers ask this contributor to rebase and prove the current branch, or sponsor a narrow replacement for the iOS streaming stability fixes on current main?
rationale: The branch contains useful bug-fix work, but the remaining blockers combine stale current-main integration and contributor-owned real behavior proof, so automation should not choose the permanent route on its own.

options.title: Ask for rebase and proof
options.body: Have the contributor rebase onto current main, adapt routing to the agent-aware session-key path, remove the changelog entry, and add a redacted real streaming chat run or logs.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow replacement
options.body: If maintainers want the fix sooner, create a small replacement preserving the useful parser/layout/load pieces and crediting this PR.

options.title: Pause or close later
options.body: If no rebase or real proof arrives after the proof window, this can move to stalled cleanup rather than staying as a landing candidate.

recommendation.title: Ask for rebase and proof
recommendation.body: Have the contributor rebase onto current main, adapt routing to the agent-aware session-key path, remove the changelog entry, and add a redacted real streaming chat run or logs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent current-main history on iOS global agent transcripts and session-key matching, which is the routing decision this PR now needs.
